## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, in the right tier (`unit`, `known_answer`, `property`,
      `statistical`, `regression`, `acceptance`; `slow` if over 5 s).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased".
- [ ] Documentation updated: docstrings (numpydoc, with coordinates stated for every array), the
      user guide, and the migration guide if a public name changes.
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass locally.
- [ ] Code ported from another author keeps that author (`Co-authored-by:` trailer).
